actions.name: glaive
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]], or [[/damage average activity=Rev09LWfUvsYkKwA]] damage in Small or Medium form.

actions.name: innate spellcasting
actions.desc: The oni's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). The oni can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: [[/item .S7VbUetIfVT7B6Eq]]{darkness}, [[/item .1N8dDMMgZ1h1YJ3B]]{invisibility} 1/day each: [[/item .eS7XnnApoxRxYXPs]]{charm person}, [[/item .RpKjTlYASrfqUPVA]]{cone of cold}, [[/item .2IWiZAJtOGDoKjiz]]{gaseous form}, [[/item .KhwiSi9fwVfUPtku]]{sleep}

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The oni makes two attacks, either with its [[/item .q7J7PERrJb2vxtlt]]{claws} or its [[/item .FC0FNE8O4rnbth8s]]{glaive}.

actions.name: regeneration
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} regains [[/healing]] at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: change shape
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium humanoid, into a Large giant, or back into its true form. Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. The only equipment that is transformed is its glaive, which shrinks so that it can be wielded in humanoid form. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, it reverts to its true form, and its glaive reverts to its normal size.

actions.name: magic weapons
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s weapon attacks are magical.
